Job Title:

Chip Implementation CAD Engineer (Digital Reference flow development)

Team: Enablement
Location: Albany (NY)--preferred, Santa Clara (CA), or Tokyo (Japan)

Role Overview:

You will focus on the implementation stages (Synthesis and PnR) of the digital reference flow. Additionally, you will lead the adoption of next-generation automation tools, including AI/ML-driven DSE (Design space exploration )

About Rapidus

Rapidus Corporation, founded in 2022, is Japan-led initiative to build a world-class advanced logic semiconductor foundry. With a bold vision to accelerate innovation, we are pioneering cutting-edge logic semiconductor research, development, design, and manufacturing to transform the global semiconductor industry.

Why Join Us

You will play a central leadership role in building the world’s most advanced 2nm and next
‑ generation enablement ecosystem
, shaping the foundation for future semiconductor innovation.
You will focus on the implementation stages (Synthesis and PnR) of the digital reference flow. Additionally, you will lead the adoption of next-generation automation tools, including AI/ML-driven DSE (Design space exploration)

Key Responsibilities:

・Develop and verify implementation steps (Synthesis/PnR) of the reference flow.
・Evaluate and productize AI/ML-driven Design Space Exploration (DSE) tools.
・Partner with EDA vendors to integrate the latest features and work with design contractors to streamline implementation methodologies.
・Author technical documentation and provide expert customer suppor t.

Qualifications:

・Experience in logic synthesis and APR (Automatic Place and Route) flows.
・Experience with advanced process nodes (7nm FinFET and beyond) is preferred but not mandatory.

Benefits

Comprehensive Health, Dental and Vision coverage, fully at company's expense (no deductibles), 401k with no employer match

jobs.title: Customer Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Role Overview

The hiring organization is seeking a Customer Data Analyst
to build and operationalize the data foundation connecting platform usage with customer-realized value. Sitting at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, Data Science, and GTM Operations, this role combines SQL, analytics, data modeling, and reporting to ensure customer data is accurate, scalable, and actionable. While the position involves participating in select customer meetings, QBRs, and onsite engagements to understand reporting requirements firsthand, the work is primarily hands-on technical execution.

Role Details

Location: United States
Work Arrangement: Remote
Employment Type: Full time

Key Responsibilities

Develop, customize, and maintain customer-facing reports, dashboards, and scalable reporting solutions across customers, service lines, and engagement types.
Write advanced SQL to query, transform, validate, and analyze customer and product data across multiple data sources, investigating questions and resolving discrepancies.
Build and maintain scalable data models, transformations, semantic definitions, and reusable downstream datasets to support reporting, QBRs, value realization, and product analytics.
Identify gaps in existing data models and address legacy data quality, structural, and modeling issues that impact reporting accuracy.
Partner with Customer Success to support data-driven QBRs, executive business reviews, renewals, and value realization conversations.
Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Data Engineering to move recurring one-off reporting toward standardized, automated capabilities and upstream product instrumentation.

Qualifications

Required:
2+ years of experience in Data Analytics, Analytics Engineering, Data Operations, Business Intelligence, Customer Analytics, or a related technical data role.
Advanced SQL skills with demonstrated experience querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting complex datasets.
Strong understanding of dimensional data modeling, data transformations, metric definitions, and analytics architecture.
Strong understanding of data quality, validation, governance, and operational workflows.
Ability to translate business and customer questions into structured data requirements.
Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large or complex datasets.
Experience creating dashboards, reports, and executive-level data narratives.
Excellent communication skills, particularly the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred:
Experience at a B2B SaaS or enterprise software company.
Hands-on experience with dbt, including building, maintaining, testing, and documenting scalable data models.
Experience supporting Customer Success, QBRs, value realization, or customer analytics.
Familiarity with audit, advisory, accounting, or professional services workflows.
Experience working with product telemetry and customer usage data.
Experience partnering directly with Data Science or Analytics Engineering teams.

Compensation & Benefits

Competitive compensation package with equity ownership
401(k)
Flexible PTO
Wellness benefits
Technology and work-from-home reimbursement
Flexible work schedules

jobs.title: Research Associate (Organ Perfusion)
jobs.description:
Until is a moonshot company building a “pause button” for biology. Our near-term focus is organ-scale reversible cryopreservation: preserving donated organs at subzero temperatures without ice formation, then rewarming them uniformly for transplant. By solving this grand challenge, we’re laying the foundation for whole-body reversible cryopreservation, giving patients a bridge to future cures.

To achieve our goal, we are assembling an interdisciplinary team to develop perfusion systems, cryoprotectant formulations, and vitrification and rewarming hardware.

We envision a future where no transplantable organ is lost to logistics, and no terminal diagnosis is final because patients can safely wait for future medicine to arrive.

About The Role

We are seeking an experienced and dedicated full-time Research Associate to join our whole organ preservation team. As Research Associate, you will play a vital role in the scientific progress of our research program. The primary focus of this role is on developing organ perfusion protocols, with an emphasis on organ isolation, preservation, and viability evaluation. The person in this role is encouraged to take on significant ownership of specific technical challenges.

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with scientists and engineers across the company on variety of methods inspired by first principles of biology, physics, and chemistry. Creative scientific engagement is encouraged, and new avenues for discovery and optimization are continuously supported.

Responsibilities

Perform pig organ isolation and ex-vivo evaluation protocols, including perfusion and histology
Work within scientific team to evaluate health of organs following cryopreservation
Survey literature and conduct experimental tests to answer critical questions towards optimizing preservation protocol
Ensure accurate sample processing and on-time data reporting

Qualifications

You have an undergraduate degree in a STEM field, or significant STEM-related training
You have 2 years experience and an excellent record of success performing complex and demanding laboratory procedures, ideally with training in ex vivo organ perfusion and viability assessment
You have demonstrated a passion for rapid problem solving and exploration of novel topics / protocols
Desire to work in a laboratory setting
You have experience or interest in physiology, with a creative approach to understanding and manipulating functions of organs
You demonstrate agency, problem solving, passion for discovery, and a drive to push the boundaries of science through meaningful involvement in an ambitious project

Benefits

Opportunity for outsized impact creating the future as an early team member
Generous medical, dental and vision insurance coverage
Flexible time off and paid holidays
Competitive compensation package, including salary and equity
401(k) retirement savings plan
FSA and commuter benefits
Subsidized lunch daily

As an equal opportunity employer, Until is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Until will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

While this represents our expected range based on market data, final compensation will be determined based on your specific qualifications and may be outside this range. Please keep in mind that the equity portion of the offer is not included in this estimate.

jobs.title: Senior Laboratory Technician (3rd Shift)
jobs.description:
Scientific

Santa Rosa, California Contract Nov 15, 2026

Location:
Santa Rosa, CA

3rd shift | Contract | Scientific

Position Overview

Join our client’s forensic toxicology laboratory as a Senior Laboratory Technician on the 3rd shift. In this role, you will be responsible for specimen preparation, extractions, and supporting analytical processes in a highly regulated environment. You will follow detailed Standard Operating Procedures and work with biological specimens, chemicals, and laboratory instrumentation.

This position requires attention to detail, adherence to safety protocols, and the ability to maintain accurate documentation throughout the analytical process. You will collaborate with supervisors and escalate any challenges promptly to ensure smooth laboratory operations.

Key Responsibilities

Read, understand, and follow written Standard Operating Procedures
Identify and assemble batches of specimens for analysis
Pour or pipette biological specimens and standards in varying volumes
Prepare and extract analytes for instrumental analysis
Load batches onto analytical instruments and initiate runs
Create Hamilton batches for merged aliquots as needed
Maintain Chain of Custody batch documentation
Communicate with supervisors and escalate issues as needed
Promote and maintain a safe, healthful work environment

Qualifications

Required: Bachelor's degree in chemistry, analytical chemistry, or a related field
Ability to work safely with biological specimens, chemicals, equipment, and instruments

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and experienced in laboratory environments. Strong communication skills and the ability to follow complex procedures are essential for success in this role.

Work Schedule

3rd shift
